risks.if_unproven: Price as may need minor parts/service.

proof_requests: Video: cold start + headlights/indicators + horn working (show dashboard/ignition).
Close-up photos of engine number/VIN and any model/year markings.
Photos of tyres (front and rear tread) and brake pads/shoes condition.
Photo of battery label/voltage (or multimeter reading) and charging test after running.
response.reason: The photos suggest an AX100-class underbone motorcycle, but the seller’s key claims ('okay to drive', 'battery everything') are not verifiable remotely without a start/ride proof and clearer identification details.
